spans.s:
चट् चट् (fr. rt. चत् and चल् and उच्-चट्),
cl. 1. P. चटति, &c., to break, break off, fall
off, separate; to rain; to cover; (in the last two senses
a various reading for कट्): Caus. P. चाटयति, -यितुम्,
to break, pierce; to kill, injure.

चटक, अस्, m. a sparrow; N. of a poet; (आस्),
m. pl. a nickname of the pupils of Vaiśampāyana
(also written चरक); (आ), f. a hen-sparrow; a
young hen-sparrow; Turdus Macrourus, = श्यामा;
the root of long pepper, = चटका-शिरस्; (इका), f.
a hen-sparrow; the root of long pepper.
—चटका-
शिरस्, n. the root of long pepper.
—चटिका-शिर,
अस्, m. or चटिका-शिरस्, n. the root of long pepper.

चटन, अम्, n. cracking, splitting; falling off in
small pieces.

चटु, उस्, उ, m. n. kind or flattering discourse; a
scream, screech; a devotional posture among ascetics;
(उस्), m. the belly.
—चटु-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of
a place.
—चटु-लालस, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased with or
desirous of flattery.

चाटु चाटु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. चट्),
pleasing or grateful words or discourse, flattery,
flattering, coaxing; distinct or clear speech; [cf.
चतु.]
—चाटु-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, speaking agreeably
or kindly, flattering, complying with a request,
humouring, complaisant; (अस्), m. a flatterer.
—चाटु-
कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking agreeably, flattering.
—चाटु-पटु, उस्, m. a jester, a buffoon, one who
makes compliments (?).
—चाटु-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्,
elegantly tremulous.
—चाटु-वटु, उस्, m. a jester;
[cf. चाटु-पटु.]
—चाटु-शत, अम्, n. repeated coax-
ing, a hundred entreaties.
—चाटूक्ति (˚टु-उक्ति), इस्,
f. agreeable language, flattery, service.

चटुलोल or चटुल्लोल, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps a cor-
ruption of चटुल-लोल), moving gracefully; tremulous
and beautiful, beautiful as a soft swimming eye &c.

चटचटा चटचटा, ind. an onomatopoetic
word for the clashing of weapons, the crackling of
fire, rattling of violent rain, &c.

चटचटाय, A. -यते, to crackle, rattle, to make
any sharp sound rapidly repeated.
चटचटायन, अम्, n. crackling, a rattling sound.

चाट चाट, अस्, m. (fr. चट् = चत् ?), a cheat,
a rogue, a speculator, one who makes away with
or embezzles money &c. entrusted to him.

चाटकैर चाटकैर, अस्, m. (fr. चटक or
चटका), a young sparrow.
चाटलिका चाटलिका, f., N. of a place.
चाटिग्राम चाटिग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a place.

चाटुक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), pleasing or
grateful discourse.
